title: Electric Field E
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the electric field E for both regions (r < R and r > R).

title: Magnetic Field B
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the magnetic field B for both regions (r < R and r > R).

title: Energy Density
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the energy density w for both regions (r < R and r > R).

title: Momentum Density
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the momentum density g for both regions (r < R and r > R).

title: Correct Units
description: Important Criteria: The student must ensure that all derived quantities have the correct physical units.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in the expressions for E, B, w, and g.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios to validate their results.
